name: Wiley's Note
summary: At Lakeshire, Wiley the Black writes a confidential note for Gryan Stoutmantle to repay a debt. Its contents point to alliances made by the Defias Brotherhood, drawing Stormwind's intelligence service into the inquiry.

sections.title: A Dangerous Ledger
sections.body: Wiley the Black, a rogue in Lakeshire, writes the dispatch in Redridge. He gives it to Gryan Stoutmantle to repay an old favor. In the note, Wiley tells what he knows of the Defias Brotherhood's plans. The Brotherhood has allies among regional gnolls, kobolds, and goblin operatives.

sections.title: The Stonemason Connection
sections.body: Wiley's note links the Defias Brotherhood to the Stonemasons Guild, which rebuilt Stormwind after the Second War. Seeing the political weight of that connection, Gryan Stoutmantle sends the note to Master Mathias Shaw, spymaster of SI:7. So Stormwind's intelligence service joins the inquiry.

faq.answer: Wiley the Black, a rogue in Lakeshire, wrote the note. He gave it to Gryan Stoutmantle of the People's Militia to repay an outstanding favor.

faq.q: What information does the note contain?
faq.answer: The note warns that the Defias Brotherhood is plotting something vast and has allies among gnolls, kobolds, and goblins. Gryan Stoutmantle seeks advice on its more sensitive contents.

faq.q: Where does the note need to be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the note
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle receives the note at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. After reading it, he orders it delivered to Master Mathias Shaw at SI:7 headquarters in Stormwind City.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle send the note to SI:7?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle suspects the note points to a deeper conspiracy than banditry. He sends it to Mathias Shaw, head of Stormwind intelligence, for investigation.

angles.text: As a rogue, you see Wiley the Black and Master Mathias Shaw, leader of SI:7, handle the missive.
As an Alliance member, you see local banditry in Westfall recognized as an organized threat to Stormwind's stability.
